turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have asthma, mostly under control. Any tips for hiking with it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Plenty of people with asthma hike happily. The main thing is always carrying your reliever inhaler where you can reach it, not buried in the bag.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. There's a gap between leaving our flat and getting our new keys, so I need somewhere to put our stuff.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, a handful of options. Listen first, I'll say when I'm finished.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A self storage unit ten minutes away, easy access every day, about eighty pounds a month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My uncle's garage, totally free, but it's damp and an hour's drive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or the removal company keeps it all in their warehouse and delivers it later, the priciest but zero effort.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The self storage unit is the middle ground. It's cheap enough and you can grab things when you need them. The warehouse is lovely if you can afford it, and the garage is only for things that can handle damp.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A buff or scarf over your mouth on cold mornings warms the air a bit. Start slowly to let your lungs adjust.
